title: NWP500 external control plan, protocol 1
description: A plan tells the integration's external control feature what state the heater should be in, and when. The feature programs it into the heater's reservation list. Top-level keys are attributes of the intent entity. Rules that span documents or depend on the device (superseded plans, bounds, allowed modes, the horizon and the entry budget) are checked by the feature and are listed in docs/external-control-spec.md. The $defs entry_item, program_item and last_write_attributes describe entity attributes the feature reports (spec section 4.2), not the plan.

protocol.description: Protocol version: "1", or "1.x" for a later minor version. Within major version 1 changes are additive (spec section 1.3). A major version the feature does not support rejects the document (unsupported_protocol).

intent_id.description: Unique per plan. The intent entity's state must change on every new plan; use this.

issued_at.description: When the scheduler made the plan. An older document never replaces a newer one (superseded).

segments.description: The timeline, in strictly increasing order of start. Each segment holds until the next segment's start; the last holds until a new plan. An empty list stops the plan: every programmed entry is withdrawn and the heater keeps its state.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 with a UTC offset. Naive timestamps are rejected. Truncated to the minute.

mode_name.description: Every mode the heater has; the adapter applies it as given. The heater skips entries during Vacation, so a later entry does not end it; an entry with the power-off mode is untested, and the mode command with that value switched the unit tested to Energy Saver (#160).

mode.description: Required on the first segment. A later segment that omits it keeps the previous segment's mode.

reassert.description: Protocol 1.1. Program this segment's entry even when its state repeats the segment before it, so a person's change is ended at its start. An entry that repeats the heater's state starts no recovery.

entry_item.description: Entity attributes, not part of a plan: one of the feature's own entries, as an item of control_last_write's added and removed (spec section 4.2). New keys may be added (spec section 1.3).

kind.description: plan or near_term; an earlier version's entry may be precedence_exit, grant_raise, grant_lower or guard. Treat a value you do not know as opaque.

owner.description: The program's label for the kind: plan, or near_term for near_term (and an earlier version's precedence_exit, grant_raise and grant_lower; guard for guard).

serves.description: The id of the segment it serves; for an earlier version's grant_raise, grant_lower or guard entry, still being removed, the old grant's id. The same string as control_next_entry's serves.

fires_at.description: The local minute the entry is written for: after any moved_1_min shift, and for a near-term entry its near-term minute. A near-term entry confirmed only after its minute never fired, and is issued again in a later write.

setpoint_raw.description: The setpoint as the device holds it, in half-degrees Celsius.

enabled.description: False only while the heater is powered off (spec section 5.9).

week.description: The weekday bit of fires_at's local date: Monday 64 to Saturday 2, Sunday 128.

device_entry.description: Entity attributes, not part of a plan: a reservation entry with the device's keys, as the heater holds it.

program_item.description: Entity attributes, not part of a plan: an item of control_program_hash's entries. A device entry, plus owner. An entry of the feature's own also carries every key of entry_item, except that mode stays the device's mode id, and mode_name holds the mode name. The Reservation Schedule sensor's own mode_name is a display label, not this.

owner.description: foreign (an entry the feature does not own, kept as read), or the owner label of one of the feature's own: plan, near_term or guard.

last_write_attributes.description: Entity attributes, not part of a plan: control_last_write's attributes once a write has been made. Before the first write they are only reason: null.

reason.description: plan, cleanup, near_term or takeover; a write stored by an earlier version may carry another. Treat a value you do not know as opaque.

added.description: The entries the write added; null when truncated.

removed.description: The entries the write removed; null when truncated, which drops removed before added.

truncated.description: True when a list is null because the attributes would exceed the recorder's 16 KiB limit, which would keep none of them. The counts are always given.

confirmed.description: For the whole write: true once the device read back the list sent; false from the first unconfirmed attempt (the retry may still confirm it), or for a live write that could not be sent; null for a simulated write (shadow).

simulated.description: True for a write made in shadow, which was not sent.

override_report.description: Entity attributes, not part of a plan: a person's change on control_override (spec section 4.2). One report per key: field; for removed, field, segment and value's kind.

field.description: setpoint, mode, removed or reservations_switched_off. Treat a value you do not know as opaque.

value.description: setpoint: half-degrees Celsius; mode: a mode name, vacation and power_off included; removed: an entry_item; reservations_switched_off: false.

segment.description: setpoint, mode: the segment in force, or null before the first; removed: the entry's serves; reservations_switched_off: null.

override_attributes.description: Entity attributes, not part of a plan: control_override's attributes. The latest report's keys at the top level, and every report in force. Off, no report is in force: the report keys are null, reports is empty and report_count is 0.

reports.description: Every report in force, oldest first, less any left out by truncated.

truncated.description: True when the oldest reports are left out of reports to stay within the recorder's 16 KiB limit. report_count counts them all.
